actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by voice vote. (text: CR H1202-1203)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by voice vote. (text: CR H1202-1203)
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 1325.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H1202-1204)
Mr. Babin moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Referred to the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology.

dimensions.assessment: Affects operators of private remote sensing space systems and federal licensing personnel.
dimensions.evidence: private remote sensing space systems refer to remote sensing instruments not owned by the U.S. government

dimensions.assessment: Halves the review time for license applications and expands annual reporting categories.
dimensions.evidence: decreases from 120 to 60 days the amount of time in which the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration must review and act on an application

dimensions.assessment: No specific fiscal or funding changes are mentioned in the text.
Amends existing statutory timelines and reporting requirements under title 51, United States Code.
dimensions.evidence: Section 60121(c) of title 51, United States Code, is amended by striking '120' and inserting '60'.

dimensions.assessment: Extends reporting requirements through September 30, 2030, alongside permanent timeline changes.
dimensions.evidence: Section 60126 of title 51, United States Code, is amended by striking 'September 30, 2020' and inserting 'September 30, 2030'.

missing_information: Any associated costs or budgetary allocations for processing licenses faster.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill modifies review timelines and reporting requirements for commercial remote sensing space system licenses, primarily affecting federal administrative processes.
